descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S05 「徽章 × 模式 → 预选的模板」 Badge × context → pre-selected template

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Default template: the admission-status badge pre-selects the template (New Admission → H&P / SNF admission, Follow-up → SOAP progress / SNF follow-up, Consult → Consult note / SNF consult), and the p …（UAT TC-21；UAT TC-21 step 1 (default template)；TFA-92599 AC 6；TFA-92599 rule 4；TFA-92584 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given One Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident

When Set the admission-status badge to New Admission, then Follow-up, then Consult, opening the generation step each time without touching the picker, in both contexts

Then Hospital: H&P / SOAP progress / Consult note is pre-selected. Nursing Home: SNF admission / SNF follow-up / SNF consult is pre-selected. The picker stays changeable (S06 changes it by hand).

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：A native select lists every option even when closed, so the evidence is which option line carries [selected], for both the 'Admission status' badge and the 'Note Format' picker. The badge is quoted (`option "Consult" [selected]`), which keeps it distinct from 'Consult note' and makes a run that never changed the badge fail instead of passing on the Follow-up default. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
